why: Guided group reflection is a study-specific, six-step clinical-teaching intervention comparing GGR with SNAPPS, not a general learning theory.

The GGNPS-CA is a named, domain-specific survey instrument used to assess nursing professionals' genomic knowledge, competence, confidence, attitudes, and ethical awareness, rather than a general instructional element.
name: GGNPS-CA: ethics-enhanced Canadian Adaptation of the Genetics and Genomics Nursing Practice Survey
product_description: A modified Genetics and Genomics Nursing Practice Survey developed to assess nurses' genomic knowledge, competence, confidence, attitudes, adoption-related factors, and ethical awareness.
